sentences.en: Bus routes and railways, both overground and underground, converged on the station.

sentences.en: The new railway line will run overground.

sentences.en: There are plans to run the line overground close to the village of Boxley.

sentences.en: Every Underground movement that goes overground is devoured by banality.

sentences.en: The area's overground train service covers east, north, west and southwest London.

sentences.en: Leyton also has an Overground station at Midland Road, on the Gospel Oak to Barking Line.

sentences.en: The Overground rail extension attracted investors to Forest Hill in southeast London.
